rowNotes.xKu: root after the row's delta; position changes only when the frame changes
rowNotes.boundsKu: room-local [from, to) of every pixel with alpha > 0; null for poses not drawn yet and for turn/action clips
rowNotes.visibleKu: width a door leaves visible; 0 = fully hidden; null without a room or bounds
rowNotes.mirrored: left travel mirrors the right-facing art about the root and negates every delta
rowNotes.approved: the drawing or clip on this row is approved; whether its root motion is approved is the profile's status
